from.place: Final appeal to Tag 09AZ: the map on connected-component spaces admits a continuous section by extremal disconnectedness and Gleason projectivity.

title: Section of a component-space surjection onto an extremally disconnected space
statement: Let X and Y be compact Hausdorff spaces [lem-weil-pbc-compact-hausdorff-bijection], with X extremally disconnected, and let f:Y\to X be a continuous surjection. Then there exists a continuous map ρ:X\to Y such that f\circ ρ=\mathrm{id}_X.
